label: LOCAL ENGINEERING DRILL - pre-declared bound, written before any fair-share A/B data existed
change_under_test: supabase/functions/_shared/tenant-concurrency.ts fair-share admission on ingest and policy, defaults capacity 16, per-tenant max 12, fair-share floor 2, Retry-After 1 s
workload: the drill's 11-key knee profile: quiet tenant 1 key, noisy tenant 10 keys at the same per-key rate (noisy = 10x quiet), 2-event ingest batches, ingest:policy = 3:1, request timeout 10 s, max_in_flight 400, 90 s per run

arms.off: AIDR_TENANT_INFLIGHT_CAPACITY=10000 and AIDR_TENANT_INFLIGHT_MAX=10000 (limiter present but never binding)

order: per rate: off, on, off, on; 60 s cool-down between runs; edge runtime restarted to switch arms
control: quiet tenant alone at its share of 56 rps (56/11 = 5.09 rps) for 90 s with the limiter on, same stack

bound_on_arm_quiet_tenant.p95_ms_max: max(2 x control p95, control p95 + 150 ms) - the same formula as the soak isolation bound
bound_on_arm_quiet_tenant.window: whole 90 s run, no warm-up exclusion

expected_on_arm_noisy_tenant: receives HTTP 429 tenant_overloaded with Retry-After (count > 0); informational only
pass_rule: every on-arm run at both rates meets every quiet-tenant bound; any miss is reported as a miss, not re-run away
